summary:
Re-ran the assets role after the user's accidental cancellation. Nothing from a previous assets run existed (no public/ folder), so everything was produced from scratch.
1) PHOTOS: 12 copyright-free photos, total 175,618 bytes. There are 10 covers (640x640 WebP, 3-31 KB each), hero-home.webp (1200x720) and empty-library.webp (900x700). Licenses and authors were confirmed on each photo page. 8 are under the Unsplash License, each page showing 'Free to use under the Unsplash License' (not Unsplash+). 4 are CC0 1.0 via Wikimedia Commons: 2 CC0-era Unsplash uploads by Lee Campbell, 1 StockSnap, 1 Pixabay. Rejected after visual and branding checks: an 'ortofon' cartridge, AirPods Max, Beats, Razer headphones, vintage scans, busy or dark shots, and a turntable with printed labels. Reviewed the final set as a mobile board in light and dark. The pink/mint headphones were too loud for the empty state, so they became a cover and a calm idle turntable became empty-library. The hero is monochrome keys with white space on the left for a title.
2) src/assets/images.ts: filled, existing API kept, optional fields and new exports added (see public_api_notes). docs/CREDITS.md written with every image, the soundfont and the software list.
3) SOUNDFONT: read abcjs 6.7.2 source. load-note.js requests `${soundFontUrl}${instrument}-mp3/${name}.mp3`. pitch-to-note-name.js uses flat names (Bb, Db, Eb, Gb, Ab). The default URL is .../midi-js-soundfonts/FluidR3_GM/, not /abcjs/. The metronome (drum, drumIntro) uses instrument 128 'percussion' with the same note-name table. Downloaded FluidR3_GM acoustic_grand_piano-mp3: 89 files, A0..C8 plus Db8, 1,983,629 bytes, matching the GitHub API listing exactly. Also downloaded 6 percussion-mp3 files (A1, Bb1, Db2, Eb5, E5, F5 = GM 33, 34, 37, 75, 76, 77; 60,534 bytes). All are in public/soundfonts with abcjs' exact structure. Licenses: FluidR3_GM.sf2 by Frank Wen (MIT per Debian packaging); the MP3 renders by midi-js-soundfonts (Benjamin Gleitzman) are declared CC BY 3.0; Paul Rosen's fork with percussion is MIT code. Chose FluidR3_GM over MusyngKite (CC BY-SA) and the 'abcjs' set (~8 MB, unclear license).
4) ICONS: original mark of five staff lines plus a vinyl disc, white on a rounded square with the #5B7CFA->#6A5CF6 gradient. Files: logo.svg, favicon.svg (simplified 3-line version for small sizes), mark.svg (monochrome, for CSS masks), favicon-32.png, icon-192.png, icon-512.png, maskable-512.png (full-bleed, disc well inside the 80% safe zone) and apple-touch-icon.png (180, opaque). Rendered with headless Chrome because ImageMagick has no rsvg delegate. Checked at 16-512 px on light and dark, and under circle and squircle masks. index.html icon links updated (my lines only).
Client feedback: docs/CLIENT-FEEDBACK.md had no entries at start or end, so no items to apply.
public_api_notes: src/assets/images.ts. The existing API is unchanged: ImageAsset, covers, heroImages, allImages, getCover(id), pickCoverId(seed). - Cover ids (10, in this order): keys-soft, vinyl-pastel, sheet-blush, keys-graphic, haze-lavender, keys-touch, headphones-pastel, sheet-grey, keys-ivory, haze-peach. - heroImages.home has id 'hero-home', 1200x720. The left ~45% is plain white, so put an INK title there, never white text. If you crop it to another aspect with object-fit: cover, use object-position ~70% 50% to keep the keys. - heroImages.emptyLibrary has id 'empty-library', 900x700, a calm turntable in soft light with white space in the top 40%. - src values are base + 'images/...' (base is './'). - NEW optional ImageAsset fields: licenseUrl, originalUrl (first publication when sourceUrl is a Commons mirror), width, height, and tone: 'light' | 'dark'. tone tells you to put ink or a scrim over 'light' images and white text over 'dark' ones. - NEW exports: - brandIcons {logo, mark, favicon}. logo.svg is the gradient tile and fine as ; give it a CSS size. mark.svg is black on transparent, meant to be used as a CSS mask with background: currentColor. - SOUNDFONT_DIR = 'soundfonts/'. - getSoundFontUrl() returns new URL('soundfonts/', document.baseURI).href. Browser only. - SOUNDFONT_VOLUME_MULTIPLIER = 3. - SOUNDFONT_PITCH_RANGE = [21, 109]. - METRONOME_DRUM: Record = {'2/4': 'dd 76 77 100 70', '3/4': 'ddd 76 77 77 100 70 70', '4/4': 'dddd 76 77 77 77 100 70 70 70', '6/8': 'dd 76 77 100 70'}. - METRONOME_PITCHES = [33, 34, 37, 75, 76, 77]. - ABCJS OPTIONS FOR THE VIEWER (synth.init options, or synthControl.setTune audioParams): { soundFontUrl: getSoundFontUrl(), soundFontVolumeMultiplier: 3 }. - abcjs fetches `${soundFontUrl}acoustic_grand_piano-mp3/.mp3` with flat names, e.g. Db4.mp3, Bb0.mp3. - The folder is 'acoustic_grand_piano-mp3', NOT 'acoustic_grand_piano' as written in BRIEF section 4. - The multiplier is required: abcjs applies x3 only when soundFontUrl equals its own FluidR3_GM CDN URL, and a local URL defaults to 1.0, which is about 3x quieter. - Metronome: add { drum: METRONOME_DRUM[timeSignature], drumBars: 1 }. - Count-in: drumIntro: 1 (0 for none). - Count-in only, no metronome: { drum: METRONOME_DRUM[ts], drumBars: 1, drumIntro: 1, drumOff: true }. abcjs turns the drum off after the intro. - Any drum pitch other than 33/34/37/75/76/77 will 404. - Pitches outside 21..109 have no sample. Clamp or drop them in the playback ABC; transpose +12 can exceed 108. abcjs logs 'Didn't load note' errors otherwise. - PWA manifest (already in vite.config.ts, no change needed): icons/icon-192.png 192x192 any, icons/icon-512.png 512x512 any (rounded tile, transparent corners), icons/maskable-512.png 512x512 maskable (full-bleed, opaque). - index.html links: favicon-32.png (PNG fallback for Safari), favicon.svg, apple-touch-icon.png 180x180 (opaque). - The existing workbox globPatterns already precache all of these: mp3 ~2.0 MB, webp 175 KB, png/svg ~110 KB.

requests.request: Pass these options when initialising abcjs synth (CreateSynth.init options or SynthController.setTune audioParams): { soundFontUrl: getSoundFontUrl(), soundFontVolumeMultiplier: SOUNDFONT_VOLUME_MULTIPLIER } (import both from src/assets/images.ts). For the metronome, use drum: METRONOME_DRUM[score.timeSignature] with drumBars: 1. For the count-in, use drumIntro: 1, and add drumOff: true when the metronome is off but the count-in is on. Clamp or drop note pitches outside SOUNDFONT_PITCH_RANGE (21..109) in the ABC used for playback (transpose can push notes past 108).

The About/credits screen should list allImages (author, sourceName, license, plus links via sourceUrl and licenseUrl). It must also show the soundfont attribution, which CC BY 3.0 requires: 'Sonidos de piano: FluidR3_GM de Frank Wen, renderizado por el proyecto midi-js-soundfonts (Benjamin Gleitzman, Paul Rosen), CC BY 3.0'. Show the software list too (Basic Pitch Apache-2.0, TensorFlow.js Apache-2.0, abcjs MIT, Untitled UI Icons MIT, Plus Jakarta Sans OFL-1.1, Motion MIT, Dexie Apache-2.0, zustand MIT, React MIT, React Router MIT, @tonejs/midi MIT, vite-plugin-pwa/Workbox MIT). Full details are in docs/CREDITS.md. brandIcons.logo can serve as the app logo there.

Update BRIEF section 4: the soundfont lives at public/soundfonts/acoustic_grand_piano-mp3/*.mp3 plus public/soundfonts/percussion-mp3/*.mp3. abcjs appends '-mp3' to the instrument name, so the path 'acoustic_grand_piano/' in the brief would not work. No vite.config change is needed: the manifest icon paths and the workbox globPatterns already match the delivered files.

For the Home banner use heroImages.home (1200x720, tone 'light'). Its left ~45% is plain white, so put any title on that side in ink color (not white). If the banner aspect differs from 5:3, use object-fit: cover with object-position ~70% 50% so the keys stay visible.

Use heroImages.emptyLibrary (900x700, calm turntable, tone 'light') for the empty state. For covers, use getCover(doc.coverId) with a fallback when it returns undefined. New/seeded items can use pickCoverId(id) or a specific id from the list in public_api_notes. Covers are 640x640: render them with object-fit: cover as circles or --r-md squares.

known_issues: Unsplash's website serves a JS proof-of-work bot check to scripts. Automating it was denied as bot-check circumvention, so I did not pursue it. Instead, license and author were verified on each Unsplash photo page with WebFetch, and files were downloaded from the images.unsplash.com CDN.

The soundfont is FluidR3_GM (the abcjs default, CC BY 3.0 renders). MusyngKite may sound richer but is CC BY-SA 3.0, and the 'abcjs' set is ~8 MB with no clear license. Attribution must appear in the About screen (request filed to settings).
Only 6 percussion samples are bundled (GM 33, 34, 37, 75, 76, 77). abcjs drum patterns using other pitches will 404. Piano samples cover MIDI 21..109 only.
The sheet-grey cover shows faint handwritten pencil annotations from the original photo, and sheet-blush has small printed Italian tempo terms. Neither shows titles or lyrics.
The SVG icons have only a viewBox (no width/height), so consumers must size them with CSS (Chrome gives them a 150x150 default in ).
verification: - Soundfont, structure: read abcjs 6.7.2 source (create-synth.js, load-note.js, pitch-to-note-name.js, instrument-index-to-name.js, abc_midi_flattener.js, abc_midi_sequencer.js) for the URL pattern, note names, default URL, volume multiplier and drum/percussion handling. - Soundfont, files: the GitHub API listing of FluidR3_GM/acoustic_grand_piano-mp3 (89 files, 1,983,629 B) matches the downloaded bytes exactly. ffprobe plus a full ffmpeg decode of all 95 mp3s found 0 bad files (mp3, 44.1 kHz, stereo). ffmpeg volumedetect confirmed all percussion samples are non-silent. - Soundfont, end-to-end: ran my own Vite dev server on port 5184 and a puppeteer-core script. abcjs synth.init + prime used soundFontUrl=http://localhost:5184/soundfonts/, soundFontVolumeMultiplier 3, the drum metronome and drumIntro 1, over an ABC containing every pitch 21..109. Results: loaded 89 piano notes (A0..Db8) plus percussion E5 and F5, errors [], prime ok, 91 soundfont responses all HTTP 200, 0 requests to other origins. - Images and icons: all 12 WebP images and 5 PNG icons fetched with HTTP 200 and decoded at the expected sizes (createImageBitmap). The 3 SVGs load in and parse as XML. index.html icon links resolve. - Licenses: confirmed on each Unsplash photo page (WebFetch) and each Commons file page (WebFetch plus the API's extmetadata). Third-party licenses were read from node_modules package.json and LICENSE files. The FluidR3 license was checked in the midi-js-soundfonts README and LICENSE.txt and in Debian's fluid-soundfont copyright file. - Typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit gives 0 errors project-wide at the end. An earlier transient error in src/App.tsx (missing ./ui/KitGallery) belonged to another agent and was fixed by them. - Sizes: covers 3.0-30.6 KB each (all under 90 KB); images total 175,618 B; icons ~110 KB. - Visual review with the Read tool: every candidate contact sheet, all final crops, a 100% zoom (no banding), icons at 16-512 px on light and dark plus maskable circle and squircle masks, and the mobile asset boards in light and dark. - Cleanup: the dev server on 5184 is stopped (pgrep finds no process; curl gets no response).
